subject: general
question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 43. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 16 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimal places) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed overall average be 43 (which is the average of the first 23 matches).

Deviation of the next 10 matches from assumed average = 16 − 43 = −27 runs per match.

Total deviation for these 10 matches = 10 × (−27) = −270 runs.

Net deviation per match spread across all 33 matches = −270 ÷ 33 ≈ −8.18 runs.

Overall average = 43 − 8.18 = 34.82 runs.

**∴ The correct answer is 34.82 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs in the first 23 matches (n₁) = 43

Average runs in the next 10 matches (n₂) = 16

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂)
